1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Engineering, Development, and Municipal Planning Committee, September 14, 2026 – 
7:00pm.  The meeting was called to order at 8:20pm with the members noted above in 
attendance.   
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to make public comment.  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming Boards and Commissions meetings was shared.  There were no 
other Board, Commission or Department Updates for this meeting. 
  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR BUSINESS  
  1. ORDER APPROVING MODIFICATION OF DEED OF CONSERVATION 
EASEMENT - 200 LEEDER HILL DRIVE 
Motion to open Item 4.1 was made by Chair Osmanu and seconded by Council 
member Foley. 
Director Fontana provided a brief overview. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item passed unanimously. 
  
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting.  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting.  
7. ADJOURN 
With no other business before the Committee, Chair Osmanu adjourned the meeting at 
8:27pm.
